name: sctpscan
summary: A network scanner for discovery and security.
highlights: -p — (default: 10000) port specifies the remote port number
-P — (default: 10000) port specifies the local port number
-l — (default: 127.0.0.1) loc_host specifies the local (bind) host for the SCTP stream with opt
-r — (default: 127.0.0.2) rem_host specifies the remote (sendto) address for the SCTP stream wi
-s — --scan -r aaa[.bbb[.ccc]] scan all machines within network
-m — --map map all SCTP ports from 0 to 65535 (portscan)
-F — --Frequent Portscans the frequently used SCTP ports Frequent SCTP ports: 1, 7, 9, 20, 21,
-a — --autoportscan Portscans automatically any host with SCTP aware TCP/IP stack

flags.name: --port
flags.description: (default: 10000) port specifies the remote port number

flags.name: --loc_port
flags.description: (default: 10000) port specifies the local port number

flags.name: --loc_host
flags.description: (default: 127.0.0.1) loc_host specifies the local (bind) host for the SCTP stream with optional local port number

flags.name: --rem_host
flags.description: (default: 127.0.0.2) rem_host specifies the remote (sendto) address for the SCTP stream with optional remote port number

flags.name: -s
flags.description: --scan -r aaa[.bbb[.ccc]] scan all machines within network

flags.name: -m
flags.description: --map map all SCTP ports from 0 to 65535 (portscan)

flags.name: -a
flags.description: --autoportscan Portscans automatically any host with SCTP aware TCP/IP stack

flags.name: -i
flags.description: --linein Receive IP to scan from stdin

flags.name: -f
flags.description: --fuzz Fuzz test all the remote protocol stack

flags.name: -B
flags.description: --bothpackets Send packets with INIT chunk for one, and SHUTDOWN_ACK for the other

flags.name: -b
flags.description: --both_checksum Send both checksum: new crc32 and old legacy-driven adler32

flags.name: -C
flags.description: --crc32 Calculate checksums with the new crc32

flags.name: -A
flags.description: --adler32 Calculate checksums with the old adler32

flags.name: -Z
flags.description: --zombie Does not collaborate to the SCTP Collaboration platform. No reporting.

flags.name: -d
flags.description: --dummyserver Starts a dummy SCTP server on port 10000. You can then try to scan it from another machine.

flags.name: -E
flags.description: --exec <script_name> Executes <script_name> each time an open SCTP port is found. Execution arguments: <script_name> host_ip sctp_port

flags.name: -t
flags.description: --tcpbridge <listen TCP port> Bridges all connection from <listen TCP port> to remote designated SCTP port.

flags.name: -S
flags.description: --streams <number of streams> Tries to establish SCTP association with the specified <number of streams> to remote designated SCTP destination.
